text: No, trees were not cut down on this property after 2020. The JRC 2020 reference data shows 0% tree cover on the property as of 2020, and the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset confirms no tree cover loss occurred post-2020. The property had some tree cover in 2000 (0.4 ha), but it was already cleared by 2020. The analysis meets the corroboration rule, as both datasets agree on the absence of tree cover in 2020 and beyond.
